messages.author: Daniel Esposito
messages.text: Unity came back with a sub-publisher breakdown. ~40 source app IDs drive most of the extra clicks. I submitted a blocklist for them on unity_video_retarget. unity_playable_installs looks clean, they don't overlap.

replies.author: Oscar Lindqvist
replies.text: Want me to track daily CTR on the campaign to see if the blocklist works?

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Yes please. If it worked, CTR should fall back toward ~1.6%.

replies.author: Oscar Lindqvist
replies.text: One week after the blocklist: CTR still ~8%, CPI still ~$0.50, installs still ~5.5k/day. No visible change :confused:

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: The fraud is moving to new app IDs faster than we block them. Escalating to our Unity account manager.
